BiblicalUsage: Judah went into captivity because of affliction and found no rest, the sorrows of death compassed the psalmist and he found trouble and sorrow, and in distress he called on the Lord, who set him in a large place. The word is the strait, the narrow place where trouble closes in.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the strait is where prayer is born: the psalmist called on the Lord in distress, and the Lord answered him and set him in a large place. The Lord answered him and set him in a large place, and that is what He still does.
RelatedEvents: Fall of Jerusalem and the Exile
